WorkflowContext.description: WorkflowBoundary._snapshot requires these nonempty producer-owned facts (decisions may be empty), limits the serialized scope bytes, and retains extra context members. NativeWorkflowBoundary emits NativeWorkflowContext. Structural validity is not current owner/source/fence authority.
